correctness.rationale: The seven edge molecules generate the entire unit ball; the rooted dual Lipschitz polytope has exactly 54 integer extreme points. The exact certificate gives 78 missing face convex decompositions and verifies the inequality for every dual extreme and each of seven edges. The resulting support inequality proves v(T)>=3||T||/4 for every real linear operator. The rank-one witness has norm 4 and radius 3; all rational identities were replayed using only Python standard library.

value.rationale: The theta graph with arm lengths 2,2,3 is the smallest simple triangle-free nonbipartite two-connected graph with two independent cycles. Its full five-dimensional free-space numerical index is a natural operator-theoretic invariant, not determined by the known C5 value or by the universal half bound. The coincidence with C5 despite an extra even cycle is a motivated structural boundary case. A universal sharp operator inequality and extremal rank-one map are supplied rather than a mere computation.
